limitations: Worker startup coverage begins after durable coordinator metadata, candidate sealing and launch-store creation.
Proof-export failure is an injected I/O error; no SIGKILL was injected at the export instruction.
Automatic supervision/replacement, OOM/resource exhaustion, active reorg/stale results and all-worker failure remain open.
Matched repetitions, larger counts, cold-full-64/post-seal boundaries, full-size CPU proving, returned Mac results and the two-hour pilot remain open.
missing_accounting_scope: The three SIGKILL owner cgroups disappeared before final accounting could be captured. Their telemetry and fleet counters remain retained. Never-started workers have no service accounting.
observer_failure_reason: Observer expected EISDIR; exclusive proof export returned EEXIST. The corrected observer continued the same journal without generating additional proofs.
root_export_failure_explanation: The root was durably accepted before exclusive file creation returned EEXIST for the injected directory. It has no fresh_typed_node log record because that record follows successful export.
scope: Initialized, sealed native candidate only. Coordinator bootstrap before durable metadata, automatic supervision, resource exhaustion, reorg, all-worker failure, cold proving and transaction throughput remain unqualified.
startup_guard_lock_scope: Held by admitted GPU process until OS exit; future entry durably revoked before workspace release.
timing_boundary_note: The final CPU-only phase restores accepted proofs and applies one isolated count-four block. It does not measure fresh solving or delivered transaction throughput.
